description.prevalence: Computed using sex-; site- and age-specific incidence to 1-;3- and 5-year prevalence ratios from Nordic countries for the period (2011-2020), and scaled using Human Development Index (HDI) ratios.

incidence.country_specific_method: Weighted average of rates from Manila and Rizal (2000-2017), applied to the 2024 population

mortality.country_specific_method: Rates (2010-2019) projected and applied to the 2024 population
